subject: MAP: environment gatecheck & preflight — API keys, org invite, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@atlashealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff - MAP preflight for POC environment

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. I've attached our initial MAP worksheet (MAP_v1.xlsx). We're ready to start gating the POC environment and want to lock the acceptance and close timeline. High level asks:

- Org invite and RBAC: AtlasHealth team needs an org-scoped collaboration with defined owner(s).
- API keys: short-lived API key flow preferred (rotate every 30d) or service account.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide CIDR ranges for our staging network.
- VPC peering: our infra team will handle peering but needs the expected ports and peering window.

Target close for POC: Sept 20 (technical acceptance). Can Redwood confirm environment gating tasks and owners by Sept 7 so we can schedule the peering window?

Attaching: MAP_v1.xlsx and a high-level network diagram will follow from our infra lead.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Director, Platform Integrations
AtlasHealth
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@atlashealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff - MAP preflight for POC environment

Alice — thanks for the MAP and the clear timeline. High level response and proposed mutual-action sequence below. I'll be the primary Redwood owner; Priyom will own infra steps, Laura will manage enablement/CS milestones.

Proposed MAP preflight (sequenced):
1) Org invite + RBAC – Redwood sends org invite (owner: Karthik) — target 9/3
2) API key provisioning – service account pattern + short-lived token guidance (owner: Priyom) — target 9/7
3) IP allowlist signoff – Atlas provides CIDR ranges; Redwood confirms token egress IPs for allowlist (owner: Karthik/Priyom) — target 9/8
4) VPC peering planning + peering window – exchange peering prep (ASNs, shared subnets, test plan) and schedule (owner: Atlas infra / Priyom) — target peering week 9/13-9/17
5) Dry-run load test & smoke checks — target 9/18
6) Technical acceptance & close — target 9/20

Dependencies & open items for your team:
- Please share the staging CIDR block and a network contact for peering (name + email).
- Confirm whether you want dedicated API keys per team or a shared service account for the POC. We recommend per-service short-lived keys if you plan to exercise scoped permissions.

I'll attach a lightweight acceptance checklist in a follow-up. If that timeline works, we'll lock owners and post the MAP as a living sheet.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@atlashealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff - MAP preflight for POC environment

+Technical notes from infra (short list):

- API keys: We can support two flows:
  * Service account tokens (recommended for automated workloads) with scoped roles; we will provision a service account and rotate a short-lived token via our token service (rotation cadence configurable).
  * Long-lived API keys for ad-hoc testing (we advise expiration at 30 days).
- Org invite: We'll send a formal org invite to atlas@redwood.io (or a list you designate). Cross-tenant RBAC: we support team-level roles (admin, dev, read-only).
- IP allowlist: For outbound requests to Atlas callbacks, we will provide the egress IP set. For inbound allowlist to Redwood (recommended): please list the Atlas CIDRs and any intermediary NAT ranges.
- VPC peering prerequisites:
  * Shared subnets must not overlap.
  * Exchange of a brief peering manifest: vpc-id, region, cidr, route table targets, and security-group guidance.
  * Peering window: we prefer a 2-hour window for route propagation and testing.

I uploaded a simple network diagram (POC_Network_Diagram.png) to the shared doc and linked our preflight (https://redwood.app/docs/poc-network-preflight).

On the security side: we can provide SOC2 / syslogs on request; for POC we typically redact production traces. If procurement needs additional artifacts, loop us in.

- PrIyom Das
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: POC_Network_Diagram.png)
From: Alice Chen <alice@atlashealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com, Miguel Ramirez <miguel.ramirez@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff - MAP preflight for POC environment

Thanks Karthik / PrIyom. Confirming next steps from our side:

- Procurement: procurement@atlashealth.com will review any MSA addenda; we have a standard POC order form.
- Network: Miguel Ramirez (miguel.ramirez@atlashealth.com) is our infra lead; he will send the CIDR ranges and peering manifest by Tues 9/7.
- API key approach: We'll start with a shared service account for rapid iteration and switch to per-team keys if we expand beyond the POC.

We can be flexible with the peering window; aiming to schedule 9/14 for peering prep and cutover on 9/15 if Redwood can confirm egress IPs and route targets by 9/8.

Procurement note: I'll expect a clean copy of your POC terms to route internally; a DocuSign link would help. Could Redwood provide the POC terms + data handling appendix by 9/6?

Thanks,
Alice
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@atlashealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff - MAP preflight for POC environment

Appended is a concise preflight acceptance checklist we use for MAP gating. If you like, we'll populate the dates in the MAP sheet and share live edits.

Redwood preflight acceptance checklist (for POC):
- Org invite accepted and at least one Atlas admin in org (owner: Karthik) — due 2026-09-03
- API key(s) issued to Atlas service account + test token validated (owner: PrIyom) — due 2026-09-07
- Atlas provides staging CIDR & peering manifest (owner: Atlas) — due 2026-09-07
- Redwood provides egress IP list & peering route targets (owner: PrIyom) — due 2026-09-08
- Peering scheduled and cutover dry-run complete (owner: Atlas/PrIyom) — target 2026-09-15
- Smoke tests and sample workload complete (owner: Atlas/Marissa) — target 2026-09-18
- Technical acceptance signoff (owner: Atlas) — target 2026-09-20

Open items to confirm:
1) Preferred API key rotation cadence for the POC (shared service account vs per-team).
2) DocuSign/POC terms for procurement (we will upload and share by 2026-09-06).

I'll update the MAP sheet and ping once the DocuSign link is ready.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
